name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering and speed. Growing up in Shanghai, he spent countless hours tinkering with engines and dreaming of Formula One. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he honed his skills at a local racing team before securing a position with a European manufacturer. His relentless pursuit of efficiency and order led him to specialize in operations management, becoming known for his meticulous planning and ability to optimize resource allocation. 

Wei joined Haas F1 Team five years ago, initially as a senior operations engineer. His data-driven approach and unwavering commitment to excellence quickly earned him the trust of his colleagues and superiors. His promotion to Head of Operations reflects his dedication to streamlining processes and ensuring the team operates at peak performance, both on and off the track. Wei is distinctive for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to inspire those around him to strive for perfection, even when faced with seemingly insurmountable challenges.
